title: Rabbi Shaul of Naveh

paragraphs: Mentioned in Kohelet Rabbah 12:10, teaching in Rabbi Shimon's name: “If someone asks you, ‘When is the end of the redemption?’ tell him: ‘For the day of vengeance is in My heart,’ it is written.” Perhaps he is Rabbi Shila Dinveh.[^1]

notes.text: The alternate Dinveh form is retained without silently identifying it with Nineveh or harmonizing the two source spellings. The possible identification is Hyman’s.
